en.headline: Tourism Board launches Hong Kong Halloween Month with street parties
en.dek: Street celebrations will run across five neighbourhoods on three consecutive Saturdays from 17 October, with free rides on decorated buses and trams for costumed visitors.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board announced its inaugural Hong Kong Halloween Month on Tuesday, featuring street parties in Central, Kai Tak, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok and Tsim Sha Tsui East on three consecutive Saturdays from 17 October, culminating on Halloween night.

According to the Board, the events will include large-scale electronic music performances, cosplay carnivals and flash mobs themed around classic Halloween elements as well as anime, film characters, street art, local culture and Cantonese pop.

Tourism Board executive director Dane Cheng said the scale expands previous single-day or single-venue activities into a month-long programme, aiming to position Hong Kong as Asia’s top Halloween destination and draw more visitors to support local businesses.

Citybus will operate free open-top sightseeing bus routes on the evenings of 17, 24 and 31 October for passengers in Halloween costumes, linking festival spots on Hong Kong Island and in Kowloon. The tram company will run two Halloween party trams on the same nights, also free for costumed riders.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦香港萬聖月 三個周六街頭派對免費乘車
zh.dek: 10月17日起一連三個周六於中環、啟德、蘭桂坊、旺角及尖沙咀東舉行街頭派對，穿萬聖節裝扮可免費乘開篷巴士及派對電車。
body: 香港旅遊發展局周二宣布首辦「香港萬聖月」，由10月17日起一連三個星期六，在中環遮打道一帶、啟德體育園、蘭桂坊、旺角朗豪坊對出及尖沙咀麼地道花園等熱點舉行萬聖節街頭派對，並於萬聖節當日圓滿結束。
活動將上演大型電音表演、Cosplay嘉年華及嘩鬼快閃等節目，主題涵蓋萬聖節經典元素，以及動漫、電影角色、潮流藝術、本地文化及廣東歌。
旅發局總幹事劉鎮漢表示，活動規模由過往集中單日或個別場地擴展為橫跨一個月的節目，希望將香港打造成萬聖節氣氛最濃厚的亞洲城市，吸引更多旅客訪港，為各區及各行各業帶來人流和商機。
旅發局聯同城巴及電車公司推出夜間免費體驗。城巴於10月17、24及31日晚上開辦萬聖節開篷觀光巴士路線，穿上萬聖節裝扮即可免費乘搭；電車公司亦推出兩架萬聖節派對電車，同樣免費讓裝扮旅客登車欣賞夜景。
